title: Scaffold redwood-quickstarts monorepo + shared config loader + contributing docs
author: Sabrina James
commits: chore: initialize monorepo layout and workspace tooling
chore(config): add shared config loader + env contract docs
docs: add CONTRIBUTING + CODE_OF_CONDUCT + SECURITY policy
ci: add basic lint/test matrix and smoke script placeholders
chore: add license, editorconfig, and formatting defaults
changed_areas: repo root scaffolding (README, LICENSE, workspace config)
tooling/ (scripts for local dev, lint, and checks)
.github/ (issue templates, PR template, CODEOWNERS, CI workflows)
body:
Summary: This PR bootstraps the redwood-quickstarts repository as a monorepo and establishes the first “template contract” primitives we’ll reuse across Python/TypeScript templates. It includes: (1) base repo scaffolding + workspace tooling, (2) a shared config loader with a consistent env var contract and validation, and (3) contribution and security guidelines to keep examples production-shaped from day one.

Motivation: ENG-2841 calls for a stable foundation so template work (RAG/agents/combined) can land quickly without each template re-inventing config, logging setup, or repo conventions. We also want to reduce common support drivers (missing timeouts/retries, noisy logs, unsafe .env patterns) by standardizing defaults and documentation at the repo level.

What’s in this PR: Repo structure: - /templates (placeholder directories for python-rag, ts-rag, agents, combined; intentionally minimal in this PR) - /packages/config (shared config loader + env parsing + validation helpers) - /tooling/scripts (lint/test entrypoints, local dev helpers, and a placeholder for smoke tests) - /.github (PR template, issue templates, CODEOWNERS, and CI workflows)

Shared config loader (packages/config): - Implements a single config surface area for all templates: Redwood API settings, telemetry settings, and runtime safety defaults (timeouts, retry policy knobs). - Adds an env var contract doc with required vs optional fields and safe defaults. - Adds validation with helpful error messages (fail fast; no silent fallback to empty API keys). - Adds support for layered config resolution: env vars > .env (local-only) > defaults.

Docs & contributing: - Adds CONTRIBUTING.md with required local tooling, how to run checks, and expectations for observability and safe defaults. - Adds SECURITY.md describing secrets handling expectations (no committed keys, .env is gitignored, guidance for rotation). - Adds a PR template that prompts authors to confirm: timeouts set, retry/backoff behavior considered, log fields include request_id/tenant, and no PII in logs.

CI: - Adds a basic CI matrix (Node + Python lint) intended to be fast and non-flaky. - Adds gitleaks secret scanning to catch accidental credential commits early. - Adds placeholders for e2e template smoke tests (to be implemented in ENG-2848).

Notes on env var contract (v0): Required (for local run): - REDWOOD_API_KEY: Redwood Hosted API key.
Recommended: - REDWOOD_BASE_URL: defaults to https://api.redwoodinference.com (docs call out staging override). - REDWOOD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS: default 60000. - REDWOOD_MAX_RETRIES: default 2 (non-streaming) with exponential backoff.
Telemetry (optional but recommended): - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES.
Logging correlation: - REDWOOD_TENANT_ID (optional; used for correlation in examples).

Review notes / discussion: - Monica Patel: Requested that config defaults align with SDK guidance and avoid “infinite retries” patterns. Updated defaults to max_retries=2 and documented that streaming reconnect semantics differ from non-streaming (templates will rely on SDK helpers in later PRs). - Dana Lo: Asked to keep TS tooling minimal and avoid framework lock-in. Kept the workspace setup generic and template folders empty; we’ll decide per-template stack in subsequent PRs. - Elliot Price: Requested a single top-level README that clearly states “this is production-minded sample code” and includes a 10-minute quickstart once templates land. Added README sections for repository goals, template catalog (placeholder), and a docs-site pointer stub. - Sahana Iyer: Asked to ensure CI jobs are deterministic and quick. Split lint checks and added caching; removed a flaky “install from git” step.

Breaking changes: None.

Follow-ups: - ENG-2842/2843/2844 will populate templates/ and reference packages/config. - ENG-2845 will define telemetry contract v1 and add validations (this PR intentionally only sets up hooks and docs). - ENG-2848 will implement e2e smoke tests that run templates against staging and verify telemetry emission.

How to test locally: - Node: pnpm install && pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r test - Python: uv sync (or pip install -r tooling/requirements.txt) && ruff check .

Merge plan: squash after approvals; keep PR small and unblock template work streams.
release_notes: Initial scaffolding for redwood-quickstarts monorepo; adds shared config loader + env contract documentation + contribution/security guidelines; introduces baseline CI (lint/test + secret scanning).
